_meta.description: The financial pivot: the result of posted ledger lines over two axes the user picks, with totals and CSV and Excel export. Opened from the Financial pivot card on the Reports page (ADR-112). The Nextcloud dashboard widgets of the same change need no manifest entry.

pages.title: Financial pivot
pages._note: Two axis pickers over a cross table with row and column totals and an export of exactly what is shown. No typed archetype fits: an index lists records of one schema, a detail shows one record, a dashboard lays out widgets; a pivot is a table whose rows AND columns are chosen by the user (reporting-custom-analysis design D3).
